This complex spirit is crafted from a blend of non-GMO, open pollinated yellow corn, soft red winter wheat, dark pumpernickel rye, and 2-row barley. It's aged six years, first in toasted and charred American white oak barrels, then in sun-blackened sherry casks. SPECIFICATIONS FORMAT 750 mL MINIMUM MATURATION TIME 6 Years ABV 48.625% (97.25 proof) MASH BILL Non-GMO, Open Pollinated Yellow Corn Ohio Soft Red Winter Wheat Dark Pumpernickel Rye 2-row Barley CASK TYPES Toasted and Charred American White Oak Solera Sherry Casks
